description.content:
Retrieves the daily telemetry for a single EV Charger.
The number of data points returned in the response corresponds to
days spanned between the start_date and end_date parameter mentioned in the request.

query.description: (Required) Requested start date of the time series data. If the start_date is not provided, then the response data begins with the previous date as start_date. Pass as String date format YYYYMMDD.
End date of the time series data. Defaults to yesterday. Pass as String date format YYYYMMDD.

description.content:
Retrieves telemetry for single EV Charger.
If no start_at is specified, defaults to previous days date, in the timezone of the system.
The end_at is calculated as the minimum of the time of the request and (start time + granularity).
The meaning of granularity is as follow:

If granularity is day, maximum 392 intervals will appear in response where each interval is of 15 mins duration. By default start_at will appear in response. If start_date parameter is passed in the url, then start_date field will appear in response.
By default end_at will appear in response. If end_date parameter is passed in the url then end_date field will appear in response.

query.description: The granularity of the telemetry data. Possible values are 'week', 'day'. Default is 'day'
Requested start date of the time series data. If the start_date and start_at is not provided, then the response data begins with the previous date as start_date. Pass as String date format YYYYMMDD.

Start time for fetching the telemetry data in Epoch time format. Alternatively one can use start_date in place of start_at for passing the start date as String in YYYYMMDD format. By default start_at will appear in response. If start_date parameter is passed in the url, then start_date field will appear in response.

info.name: The Enlighten Systems Device Level Production Monitoring EV Charger Monitoring API

description.content:
The Enlighten Systems API is a JSON-based API that provides access to performance data for a PV system. By using the Enlighten Systems API, you agree to the Enphase Energy API License Agreement.

Please note that the Enlighten Systems API does not provide performance data at a panel or microinverter level.
